fields.Name: ORD-43 - Amount Change
fields.Description: Lowering the amount of a booked term (AC1-AC11). Orders.AmendArrangement with NewAmount and Preview plans the change against the term's staged recognition entries and the order's schedule: the share of the reduction already earned is the catch-up, every staged entry from today on is offset and what is left at the new price is re-spread, and the reduction and its tax come off the instalments not yet invoiced before any document is credited. Without Preview it records a Price concession, applied when approved. What the uninvoiced instalments cannot absorb is credited by a credit memo on the invoice or the order, or refunded when a refund is asked for (AC7-AC9, AC11), and the customer's memo document is rendered from what the approval recorded. AC10 checks that after one of two lines is lowered, each later instalment bills each line what it has left.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A 1,200 term billed as a whole previews a cut to 900 with a value of 300, a credit memo equal to the reduction and its tax applied to the order, a catch-up equal to the earned share of the reduction, one offset per staged entry from today on, and a new schedule that sums to what is left; nothing is written. Billed in four instalments of 300 with the first invoiced, the 300 reduction leaves instalments 2 to 4 at 200 each and needs no credit memo. Naming the invoiced instalment credits it with the whole reduction and changes no instalment; naming an uninvoiced one is refused. An increase, a missing acknowledgment role and a placed renewal are refused, and so is recording a cut that needs a credit memo. Recorded inside authority, the cut is approved and applied: the term is 900, instalments 2 to 4 are lowered, the order's balance falls by the reduction and its tax, the term recognises 300 less in all with one catch-up entry, an AmountChanged event is logged, accounting's task is assigned to the acknowledgment role and not the requester, and instalment 2 still invoices at its lowered amount. Recorded outside authority it is Pending and changes nothing until approved, then applies the same way. Recording a refund, or a credit on an invoice already sent, is refused.
